def sign_aggregate_chain_fork_proof(items, prune_policy,
                                    authorization_policy, keyring, moment,
                                    issuer, version):
    """Sign the fork summary of a decision aggregate chain batch.

    ``items`` is the same non-empty list of ``{"id", "root",
    "successors", "policies"}`` dicts
    :func:`verify_decision_aggregate_chains` takes; ``prune_policy`` is
    the shared invariant original ``{"batch","sites","threshold"}``
    pruning policy and ``authorization_policy`` the shared invariant site
    authorization policy, ``keyring`` follows the existing rules,
    ``moment`` is the signing time and ``issuer``/``version`` name the
    signing credentials.  The batch first runs through the exact
    :func:`verify_decision_aggregate_chains` rules and the proof is
    issued only when the resulting report records at least one fork (a
    fork-free report raises :class:`ValueError`).  No file is read or
    written and no argument is modified.

    The proof is one canonical compact UTF-8 JSON object -- every object
    key recursively sorted, non-ASCII preserved, no trailing newline or
    any other trailing byte -- carrying exactly ``payload`` and
    ``signature``.  The payload binds exactly ``chains`` (every input
    chain in input order: ``id``, the ``root`` digest, every
    ``successors`` digest and the canonical digest of every versioned
    decision site policy in the complete ``policies`` history),
    ``issuer``, ``keyVersion``, ``moment``, ``prunePolicy`` (the
    lowercase hex SHA-256 of the canonical compact prune policy
    encoding), ``report`` (the complete chain-batch report),
    ``authorizationPolicy`` (the SHA-256 of the canonical compact site
    authorization policy) and ``version`` (the integer 1).  ``signature``
    is the lowercase hex HMAC-SHA256 of the canonical compact payload
    bytes under the key the keyring binds to the exact issuer and
    version, with no fallback.

    A parameter or public field type fault raises :class:`TypeError` (a
    :class:`bool` never poses as an int); an empty list, an empty or
    duplicate id, a wrong policy count, an empty issuer, a non-positive
    version, a negative moment, an illegal shared policy or a report
    without a fork raises :class:`ValueError`; and unknown, revoked,
    not-yet-valid or expired credentials raise
    :class:`AuthenticationError`.
    """
    validated_items = _validated_fac_chain_batch(items)
    validated_prune_policy = _validated_adjudication_policy(prune_policy)
    validated_authorization_policy = _validated_prune_batch_site_policy(
        authorization_policy
    )
    validated_keyring = _validated_keyring(keyring)
    sign_moment = _fe_moment(moment, "moment")
    if not isinstance(issuer, str):
        raise TypeError("issuer must be a str")
    if issuer == "":
        raise ValueError("issuer must be non-empty")
    if isinstance(version, bool) or not isinstance(version, int):
        raise TypeError("version must be an int")
    if version <= 0:
        raise ValueError("version must be positive")

    report = verify_decision_aggregate_chains(
        validated_items, prune_policy, authorization_policy, keyring,
        sign_moment,
    )
    if not report[CHAINS_FORKS]:
        raise ValueError(
            "an aggregate chain fork proof requires at least one fork in "
            "the chain report"
        )
    entry = _usable_checkpoint_key(
        validated_keyring, issuer, version, sign_moment
    )
    payload = {
        FORK_PROOF_CHAINS: _pac_chain_materials(validated_items),
        VD_ISSUER: issuer,
        KEY_VERSION: version,
        CP_MOMENT: sign_moment,
        CF_PROOF_PRUNE_POLICY: hashlib.sha256(
            _verdict_policy_bytes(validated_prune_policy)
        ).hexdigest(),
        FORK_PROOF_REPORT: copy.deepcopy(report),
        _ACF_PROOF_AUTHORIZATION_POLICY: hashlib.sha256(
            _prune_batch_site_policy_bytes(validated_authorization_policy)
        ).hexdigest(),
        VERSION: AGGREGATE_CHAIN_FORK_PROOF_VERSION,
    }
    signature = hmac.new(
        bytes.fromhex(entry[SECRET]),
        _prune_compact(payload),
        hashlib.sha256,
    ).hexdigest()
    return _prune_compact({TICKET_PAYLOAD: payload, SIGNATURE: signature})


def _verify_acf_fork_proof_core(
    raw: bytes,
    validated_prune_policy: dict,
    validated_authorization_policy: dict,
    validated_keyring: dict[str, list[dict]],
    verify_moment: int,
) -> dict:
    """Verify one aggregate chain fork proof against validated materials.

    Shared core of the batch verifier; the caller owns the
    argument-type and shared-material validation.  The returned dict is
    freshly built solely from authenticated proof material.
    """
    payload, signature, chains = _parse_acf_fork_proof(raw)
    expected_prune_digest = hashlib.sha256(
        _verdict_policy_bytes(validated_prune_policy)
    ).hexdigest()
    if payload[CF_PROOF_PRUNE_POLICY] != expected_prune_digest:
        raise _acf_proof_invalid(
            "prune policy digest does not match the prune policy"
        )
    expected_authorization_digest = hashlib.sha256(
        _prune_batch_site_policy_bytes(validated_authorization_policy)
    ).hexdigest()
    if payload[_ACF_PROOF_AUTHORIZATION_POLICY] != expected_authorization_digest:
        raise _acf_proof_invalid(
            "authorization policy digest does not match the authorization "
            "policy"
        )
    if payload[CP_MOMENT] > verify_moment:
        raise _acf_proof_invalid(
            "moment must not be later than the verification moment"
        )

    key_entry = _usable_checkpoint_key(
        validated_keyring, payload[VD_ISSUER], payload[KEY_VERSION],
        verify_moment,
    )
    expected_signature = hmac.new(
        bytes.fromhex(key_entry[SECRET]),
        _prune_compact(payload),
        hashlib.sha256,
    ).hexdigest()
    if not hmac.compare_digest(expected_signature, signature):
        raise AuthenticationError(
            "aggregate chain fork proof signature does not match"
        )

    return {
        FORK_PROOF_CHAINS: copy.deepcopy(chains),
        VD_ISSUER: payload[VD_ISSUER],
        KEY_VERSION: payload[KEY_VERSION],
        CP_MOMENT: payload[CP_MOMENT],
        PAFD_PRUNE_POLICY_DIGEST: expected_prune_digest,
        _ACF_AUTHORIZATION_POLICY_DIGEST: expected_authorization_digest,
        FORK_PROOF_DIGEST: hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),
        FORK_PROOF_REPORT: copy.deepcopy(payload[FORK_PROOF_REPORT]),
        VERSION: AGGREGATE_CHAIN_FORK_PROOF_VERSION,
    }


# -- Offline batch verification of aggregate chain fork proofs ----------------

def _acf_proofs_item_report(
    item_id: str, status: str, error: str | None, result: dict | None
) -> dict:
    """One aggregate chain fork proof batch report, fixed key order."""
    return {
        CHECKPOINT_ITEM_ERROR: error,
        ID: item_id,
        VERDICT_ITEM_RESULT: result,
        STATUS: status,
    }


def _verify_acf_fork_proof_item(
    item: dict,
    validated_prune_policy: dict,
    validated_authorization_policy: dict,
    validated_keyring: dict[str, list[dict]],
    moment: int,
) -> dict:
    """Verify one aggregate chain fork proof in isolation.

    Unknown, revoked, not-yet-valid or expired credentials and a wrong
    signature make the item ``unauthenticated``; every encoding,
    key-set, version, digest, ordering, reference or report-binding
    fault makes it ``invalid-proof``; a passing proof is ``verified``.
    """
    item_id = item[ID]
    try:
        result = _verify_acf_fork_proof_core(
            item[FORK_PROOF_ITEM_PROOF],
            validated_prune_policy,
            validated_authorization_policy,
            validated_keyring,
            moment,
        )
    except AuthenticationError as exc:
        return _acf_proofs_item_report(
            item_id, _ACF_PROOFS_UNAUTHENTICATED, str(exc), None
        )
    except (InvalidChainProofError, TypeError) as exc:
        # A TypeError here can only come from a wrong JSON field type
        # *inside* the proof bytes; the public argument types were all
        # validated before the batch ran.
        return _acf_proofs_item_report(
            item_id, _ACF_PROOFS_INVALID, str(exc), None
        )
    return _acf_proofs_item_report(
        item_id, _ACF_PROOFS_VERIFIED, None, result
    )


def verify_aggregate_chain_fork_proofs(items, prune_policy,
                                      authorization_policy, keyring, moment):
    """Verify a whole batch of aggregate chain fork proofs offline.

    ``items`` is a non-empty list; each item is a dict with exactly the
    keys ``id`` (a non-empty str, unique across the batch) and ``proof``
    (the bytes :func:`sign_aggregate_chain_fork_proof` produced).  The

def _adjudicate_acf_one(
    item: dict,
    prune_policy_digest: str,
    authorization_policy_digest: str,
    signer_site_policy: dict,
    keyring: dict[str, list[dict]],
    moment: int,

    """Verify, authorize and authenticate one aggregate chain fork proof.

    The proof is first checked through the exact aggregate chain fork
    proof structural rules, then the signing site and key version are
    authorized exactly against the separate signer site policy with no
    fallback, and finally the HMAC is checked against the current
    keyring.  Any failure rejects just this row with one fixed reason
    and never affects the other items.

    item_id = item[ID]
    raw_proof = item[FORK_PROOF_ITEM_PROOF]
    proof_digest = hashlib.sha256(raw_proof).hexdigest()

    def structural_invalid() -> dict:
        return _cf_row(
            item_id, proof_digest, None, None, None,
            _PAFD_CONCLUSION_INVALID, _PAFD_REASON_INVALID_PROOF,
        )

    try:
        payload, signature, _chains = _parse_acf_fork_proof(raw_proof)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return structural_invalid()

    site = payload[VD_ISSUER]
    key_version = payload[KEY_VERSION]
    try:
        edges = _pac_fork_proof_edges(payload)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return structural_invalid()

    def reject(reason: str) -> dict:
        return _cf_row(
            item_id, proof_digest, site, key_version, edges,
            _PAFD_CONCLUSION_INVALID, reason,
        )

    # Both shared policy digests must match and the proof must not be
    # dated after the adjudication moment; a mismatch makes the claimed
    # identity untrustworthy, so the row carries none.  Authorization
    # itself is governed by the separate signer site policy.
    if payload[CF_PROOF_PRUNE_POLICY] != prune_policy_digest:
        return structural_invalid()
    if payload[_ACF_PROOF_AUTHORIZATION_POLICY] != authorization_policy_digest:
        return structural_invalid()
    if payload[CP_MOMENT] > moment:
        return structural_invalid()

    allowed_versions = signer_site_policy[ADJ_SITES].get(site)
    if allowed_versions is None:
        return reject(REASON_UNAUTHORIZED_SITE)
    if key_version not in allowed_versions:
        return reject(REASON_UNAUTHORIZED_VERSION)

    key_entry = None
    for candidate in keyring.get(site, ()):
        if candidate[VERSION] == key_version:
            key_entry = candidate
            break

        return reject(REASON_CREDENTIAL_UNAVAILABLE)

    if moment < key_entry[NOT_BEFORE]:

    if moment > key_entry[NOT_AFTER]:
        return reject(REASON_EXPIRED)

    expected_signature = hmac.new(
        bytes.fromhex(key_entry[SECRET]),
        _prune_compact(payload),
        hashlib.sha256,
    ).hexdigest()
    if not hmac.compare_digest(expected_signature, signature):
        return reject(REASON_BAD_SIGNATURE)

    return _cf_row(
        item_id, proof_digest, site, key_version, edges,
        _PAFD_CONCLUSION_VALID, None,

def _pac_chain_edge_nodes(item: dict) -> list[str]:
    """The digest chain a batch item walks: root then each successor."""
    nodes = [hashlib.sha256(item[PAC_BATCH_ROOT]).hexdigest()]
    for successor in item[PAC_BATCH_SUCCESSORS]:
        nodes.append(hashlib.sha256(successor).hexdigest())
    return nodes


def _pac_chain_item_report(
    item_id: str, status: str, error: str | None, result: dict | None
) -> dict:
    """One prune aggregate chain batch report with the fixed key order."""
    return {
        CHECKPOINT_ITEM_ERROR: error,
        ID: item_id,
        VERDICT_ITEM_RESULT: result,
        STATUS: status,
    }


def _verify_pac_chain_item(
    item: dict, prune_policy: object, keyring: object, verify_moment: int
) -> dict:
    """Verify one batch chain in isolation and report its outcome.

    The root aggregate is verified on its own first, so a root fault is
    reported ``invalid-root`` while a successor or chain-binding fault
    is ``invalid-chain``; credential and signature faults are
    ``unauthenticated`` and a passing chain is ``verified``.  A
    :class:`TypeError` here can only come from a wrong field type
    *inside* a packet; the public argument types were all validated
    before the batch ran.
    """
    item_id = item[ID]
    root = item[PAC_BATCH_ROOT]
    successors = item[PAC_BATCH_SUCCESSORS]
    policies = item[PAC_BATCH_POLICIES]
    try:
        verify_prune_aggregate_chain(
            root, [], prune_policy, policies[:1], keyring, verify_moment
        )
    except AuthenticationError as exc:
        return _pac_chain_item_report(
            item_id, PAC_CHAINS_UNAUTHENTICATED, str(exc), None
        )
    except (InvalidPruneBatchAggregateError, TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
        return _pac_chain_item_report(
            item_id, PAC_CHAINS_INVALID_ROOT, str(exc), None
        )
    try:
        result = verify_prune_aggregate_chain(
            root, successors, prune_policy, policies, keyring, verify_moment
        )
    except AuthenticationError as exc:
        return _pac_chain_item_report(
            item_id, PAC_CHAINS_UNAUTHENTICATED, str(exc), None
        )
    except (InvalidPruneBatchAggregateError, InvalidAggregateChainError,
            TypeError, ValueError) as exc:
        return _pac_chain_item_report(
            item_id, PAC_CHAINS_INVALID_CHAIN, str(exc), None
        )
    return _pac_chain_item_report(
        item_id, PAC_CHAINS_VERIFIED, None, result
    )

    """Verify a batch of prune aggregate chains and spot successor forks.

    Each item holds exactly a unique non-empty ``id``, its ``root``

    policy count or an illegal moment raises :class:`ValueError`.

    through the exact :func:`verify_prune_aggregate_chain` rules: one
    chain's failure never stops a later chain or changes an earlier
    report.  A root fault reports ``invalid-root``, a successor or
    chain-binding fault ``invalid-chain`` and a credential or signature
    fault ``unauthenticated``, each with a null ``result``; a passing
    chain reports ``verified``.

    only successor trajectories under the same aggregate root are
    compared: the same predecessor digest pointing at two distinct
    successor digests is a fork (a mere prefix extension -- the same
    chain growing longer -- is not).  Every verified chain crossing a

    ``version`` (the integer 1).  ``forks`` is sorted by ``rootDigest``
    then ``predecessorDigest``; each entry carries exactly

    successor digests, ascending) and ``ids`` (the ascending ids of the

    order and carries, in this key order, ``error`` (null exactly when
    verified), ``id``, ``result`` (the single-chain summary when the
    chain verified, otherwise null) and ``status``.  No file is read or
    written and no input is modified.
    """

    _validated_adjudication_policy(prune_policy)

return _pafd_row(
        item_id, proof_digest, site, key_version, edges,
        _PAFD_CONCLUSION_VALID, None,
    )


_PAFD_EDGE_SET = frozenset[tuple[str, str, tuple[str, ...]]]


def _pafd_content(row: dict) -> _PAFD_EDGE_SET:
    """The complete fork edge set one authenticated row declares."""
    return frozenset(_pac_fork_edge_triples(row[PAFD_EDGES]))


def _tally_pac_fork_rows(
    rows: list[dict],
) -> tuple[bool, dict[str, _PAFD_EDGE_SET]]:
    """Group authenticated rows per site by their complete edge sets.

    Two rows from one site are the same declaration only when their
    complete fork edge set -- every ``(rootDigest, predecessorDigest,
    successors)`` triple -- agrees, regardless of the proof digest.
    The smallest-id row of one identical set is the vote and extras are
    ``duplicate``, while two distinct edge sets from one site are both a
    ``contradiction``.  Returns ``(contradicted, votes)`` where
    ``votes`` maps each non-contradicting site to its one edge set.
    """
    by_site: dict[str, dict[_PAFD_EDGE_SET, list[dict]]] = {}
    for row in rows:
        if row[ADJ_CONCLUSION] in (
            _PAFD_CONCLUSION_VALID,
            _PAFD_CONCLUSION_DUPLICATE,
            _PAFD_CONCLUSION_CONTRADICTION,
        ):
            by_site.setdefault(row[VD_ISSUER], {}).setdefault(
                _pafd_content(row), []
            ).append(row)

    contradicted = False
    votes: dict[str, _PAFD_EDGE_SET] = {}
    for site, groups in by_site.items():
        if len(groups) > 1:
            contradicted = True
            ordered_groups = sorted(
                groups.values(),
                key=lambda members: min(member[ID] for member in members),
            )
            for members in ordered_groups:
                members.sort(key=lambda row: row[ID])
                members[0][ADJ_CONCLUSION] = _PAFD_CONCLUSION_CONTRADICTION
                members[0][ADJ_REASON] = REASON_CONTRADICTION
                for extra in members[1:]:
                    extra[ADJ_CONCLUSION] = _PAFD_CONCLUSION_DUPLICATE
                    extra[ADJ_REASON] = REASON_DUPLICATE
        else:
            content, members = next(iter(groups.items()))
            members.sort(key=lambda row: row[ID])
            members[0][ADJ_CONCLUSION] = _PAFD_CONCLUSION_VALID
            members[0][ADJ_REASON] = None
            for extra in members[1:]:
                extra[ADJ_CONCLUSION] = _PAFD_CONCLUSION_DUPLICATE
                extra[ADJ_REASON] = REASON_DUPLICATE
            votes[site] = content
    return contradicted, votes


def adjudicate_prune_aggregate_forks(
    items, prune_policy, site_policy, keyring, moment, issuer, version
):
    """Adjudicate multi-site prune aggregate fork proofs offline.

    ``items`` is a non-empty list; each item contains exactly a unique
    non-empty ``id`` and ``proof`` bytes produced by
    :func:`sign_prune_aggregate_fork_proof`.  ``prune_policy`` is the
    shared invariant original ``{"batch","sites","threshold"}`` pruning
    policy the proofs were issued against; ``site_policy`` carries
    exactly ``sites`` (a non-empty map of each authorized non-empty site
    to its non-empty set of allowed positive key versions) and
    ``threshold`` (a positive integer no greater than the site count).
    ``keyring`` follows the existing rules, ``moment`` is the
    non-negative adjudication moment and ``issuer``/``version`` name the
    adjudicator credentials.  No file is read or written and no input is
    modified.

    Every proof is first verified through the existing prune aggregate
    fork proof rules, then authorized by the exact signing site and key
    version its payload names with no fallback, then authenticated
    against the current keyring.  An invalid, unauthenticated or
    unauthorized proof rejects just that item with one fixed reason
    (``invalid-proof``, ``unauthorized-site``, ``unauthorized-version``,
    ``credential-unavailable``, ``revoked``, ``not-yet-valid``,
    ``expired`` or ``bad-signature``) while the later items are still
    processed.  For one site the complete fork edge set counts once --
    extra proofs declaring an identical edge set are ``duplicate`` --
    while distinct valid edge sets from one site are a
    ``contradiction``.  Distinct sites must agree exactly on the
    complete fork edge set made of the root digest, the forking
    predecessor digest and the sorted legal successor digests; any
    contradiction or cross-site disagreement is ``conflicted`` with a
    null common edge set and no majority can outvote it.  A unique edge
    set backed by at least the threshold of distinct sites is
    ``accepted``; the same unique set short of the threshold stays
    ``insufficient`` but keeps that common set; with no valid vote the
    common set is null.

    The result is one canonical compact UTF-8 JSON object with
    recursively sorted keys, non-ASCII preserved and no trailing byte,
    carrying exactly ``payload`` and ``signature``.  The payload binds
    exactly ``common`` (the sorted common fork edge set, or null),
    ``issuer``, ``items`` (the rows stably sorted by site then id, each
    carrying ``conclusion``, its authenticated ``edges`` or null, ``id``,
    ``keyVersion``, ``proofDigest``, ``reason`` and ``site``),
    ``keyVersion``, ``prunePolicyDigest``, ``proofs`` (each proof digest
    in the original input order), ``sitePolicyDigest``, ``status`` and
    ``version`` (the integer 1).  ``signature`` is the lowercase hex
    HMAC-SHA256 of the canonical compact payload bytes under the exact
    issuer/version key.

    A parameter, container or public-field type fault raises
    :class:`TypeError` (a :class:`bool` never poses as an int); an empty
    list, an empty or duplicate id, or an illegal prune/site policy,
    threshold, moment, issuer or version raises :class:`ValueError`;
    unknown, revoked, not-yet-valid or expired adjudicator credentials
    raise :class:`AuthenticationError`.
    """
    validated_items = _validated_pac_fork_proof_items(items)
    validated_prune_policy = _validated_adjudication_policy(prune_policy)
    validated_site_policy = _validated_prune_batch_site_policy(site_policy)
    validated_keyring = _validated_keyring(keyring)
    if isinstance(moment, bool) or not isinstance(moment, int):
        raise TypeError("moment must be an int")
    if moment < 0:
        raise ValueError("moment must be non-negative")
    if not isinstance(issuer, str):
        raise TypeError("issuer must be a str")
    if issuer == "":
        raise ValueError("issuer must be non-empty")
    if isinstance(version, bool) or not isinstance(version, int):
        raise TypeError("version must be an int")
    if version <= 0:
        raise ValueError("version must be positive")

    prune_policy_digest = hashlib.sha256(
        _verdict_policy_bytes(validated_prune_policy)
    ).hexdigest()

    proof_digests = [
        hashlib.sha256(item[FORK_PROOF_ITEM_PROOF]).hexdigest()
        for item in validated_items
    ]
    rows = [
        _adjudicate_pac_fork_one(
            item, prune_policy_digest, validated_site_policy,
            validated_keyring, moment,
        )
        for item in validated_items
    ]

    contradicted, votes = _tally_pac_fork_rows(rows)

    edge_sets = set(votes.values())
    if contradicted or len(edge_sets) > 1:
        status = _PAFD_STATUS_CONFLICTED
        common = None
    elif len(edge_sets) == 1:
        common = _sorted_pac_fork_edge_objects(next(iter(edge_sets)))
        if len(votes) >= validated_site_policy[ADJ_THRESHOLD]:
            status = _PAFD_STATUS_ACCEPTED
        else:
            status = _PAFD_STATUS_INSUFFICIENT
    else:
        status = _PAFD_STATUS_INSUFFICIENT
        common = None

    rows.sort(
        key=lambda row: (
            row[VD_ISSUER] is not None,
            row[VD_ISSUER] or "",
            row[ID],
        )

    if not isinstance(anchor, bytes):

    payload, signature = _cda_parse_anchor(anchor)
    validated_items = _validated_fac_chain_batch(items)
    if not isinstance(target, str):

    if target == "":

    for position, item in enumerate(validated_items):

def _verify_adc_chain(
    root: bytes,
    successors: list,
    validated_prune_policy: dict,
    validated_authorization_policy: dict,
    validated_site_policy: dict,
    validated_policies: list[dict],
    validated_keyring: dict[str, list[dict]],
    verify_moment: int,
) -> dict:
    """Verify one aggregate decision chain hop by hop."""
    _verify_adc_chain_root(
        root, validated_prune_policy, validated_authorization_policy,
        validated_site_policy,
        _pac_plain_site_policy(validated_policies[0]),
        validated_keyring, verify_moment,
    )
    root_digest = hashlib.sha256(root).hexdigest()
    view = _adc_root_view(root)
    head_packet = root
    head_status = view[STATUS]
    head_declaration = view[_ACFD_DECLARATION]
    head_policy_version = validated_policies[0][DS_POLICY_VERSION]

    previous_packet = root
    for index, successor in enumerate(successors):
        hop = _verify_adc_hop(
            successor, view, hashlib.sha256(previous_packet).hexdigest(),
            validated_policies[index], validated_policies[index + 1],
            validated_prune_policy, validated_authorization_policy,
            validated_site_policy, validated_keyring, verify_moment,
        )
        view = hop["view"]
        previous_packet = successor
        head_packet = successor
        head_status = view[STATUS]
        head_declaration = view[_ACFD_DECLARATION]
        head_policy_version = view[_ADC_POLICY_VERSION]

    common_digest = None
    if head_declaration is not None:
        common_digest = hashlib.sha256(
            _prune_compact(head_declaration)
        ).hexdigest()
    return {
        _ADC_ROOT_DIGEST: root_digest,
        FAC_HEAD_DIGEST: hashlib.sha256(head_packet).hexdigest(),
        _ADC_HEIGHT: view[_ADC_HEIGHT],
        FAC_POLICY_VERSION: head_policy_version,
        STATUS: head_status,
        FAC_COMMON_DIGEST: common_digest,
    }


def verify_aggregate_decision_chain(
    root, successors, prune_policy, authorization_policy, site_policy,
    policies, keyring, moment,
):
    """Verify one aggregate decision supersession chain hop by hop.

    ``root`` is the chain's aggregate chain fork decision aggregate
    packet (:func:`aggregate_aggregate_chain_fork_decisions`) and
    ``successors`` the ordered successor packets (possibly empty for a
    height-zero chain).  ``prune_policy`` is the invariant original
    ``{"batch", "sites", "threshold"}`` pruning policy,
    ``authorization_policy`` the invariant site authorization policy and
    ``site_policy`` the invariant fork-proof signer site policy;
    ``policies`` is the complete versioned **decision** site policy
    history -- one entry per stage (the root policy plus one per
    successor), so its length is ``len(successors) + 1`` and the first
    carries ``policyVersion`` 1.  Only the root, the ordered successors,
    the three invariant policies, the policy history, the current
    keyring and the verification moment are consulted; no file is read
    or written and no input is modified.

    An empty successor list still verifies the root in full.  For a
    non-empty chain every hop is re-checked: the root, predecessor and
    height links, the append-only decision prefix, the old/new policy
    digests and single-step version rule, the non-decreasing effective
    moment, the invariant prune, site authorization and signer site
    policies, the per-new-decision re-authentication and the full stage
    re-tally, the verdict state machine and dual-policy sealer
    authorization, and the exact-issuer/version HMAC with a credential
    usable at both the hop's effective moment and the verification
    moment.

    On success returns a fresh mapping with the fixed keys
    ``rootDigest``, ``headDigest``, ``height`` (0 for a bare root),
    ``policyVersion`` (the head policy's version), ``status`` and
    ``commonDigest`` (the SHA-256 of the canonical common declaration
    when one is bound, otherwise null).  A non-bytes argument or a
    public field of the wrong type raises :class:`TypeError`; an empty
    value, an illegal version, a wrong policy count or a backwards
    moment raises :class:`ValueError`; a bad root raises
    :class:`InvalidAggregateChainForkDecisionAggregateError`; a bad
    successor or chain binding raises
    :class:`InvalidAggregateDecisionChainError`; a credential or
    signature fault raises :class:`AuthenticationError`.
    """
    if not isinstance(root, bytes):
        raise TypeError("root must be bytes")
    if not isinstance(successors, list):
        raise TypeError("successors must be a list")
    for index, successor in enumerate(successors):
        if not isinstance(successor, bytes):
            raise TypeError(f"successor {index} must be bytes")
    validated_prune_policy = _validated_adjudication_policy(prune_policy)
    validated_authorization_policy = _validated_prune_batch_site_policy(
        authorization_policy
    )
    validated_site_policy = _validated_prune_batch_site_policy(site_policy)
    validated_policies = _pac_validated_policy_sequence(policies)
    validated_keyring = _validated_keyring(keyring)
    verify_moment = _fe_moment(moment, "moment")
    if len(validated_policies) != len(successors) + 1:
        raise ValueError(
            "policies must provide one entry per chain stage (one more than "
            "the number of successors)"
        )
    if validated_policies[0][DS_POLICY_VERSION] != 1:
        raise ValueError("the root stage policy must carry policyVersion 1")

    return _verify_adc_chain(
        root, successors, validated_prune_policy,
        validated_authorization_policy, validated_site_policy,
        validated_policies, validated_keyring, verify_moment,
    )

class InvalidAggregateDecisionChainForkDecisionError(ValueError):

def _adcf_proof_invalid(

def _reject_duplicate_adcf_proof_keys(pairs: list[tuple]) -> dict:
    """``object_pairs_hook`` turning duplicate proof keys into an error."""
    result: dict = {}
    for key, value in pairs:
        if key in result:
            raise _adcf_proof_invalid(f"duplicate key {key!r} in object")
        result[key] = value
    return result


def _reject_duplicate_adcf_decision_keys(pairs: list[tuple]) -> dict:
    """``object_pairs_hook`` turning duplicate decision keys into an error."""
    result: dict = {}
    for key, value in pairs:
        if key in result:
            raise _adcf_decision_invalid(f"duplicate key {key!r} in object")
        result[key] = value
    return result


def _parse_adcf_fork_proof(raw: object) -> tuple[dict, str, list[dict]]:
    """Validate aggregate decision chain fork proof bytes structurally.

    Returns ``(payload, signature, chains)``.  A non-bytes argument or a
    public field of the wrong type raises :class:`TypeError` (a
    :class:`bool` never poses as an int); every encoding, key-set,
    version, digest, count, ordering, reference or report-binding fault
    raises :class:`InvalidAggregateDecisionChainForkProofError`.  The
    three policy bindings, the moment and the signature are checked by
    the proof verifier.
    """
    if not isinstance(raw, bytes):
        raise TypeError("proof must be bytes")
    if not raw or raw[-1:] in (b"\n", b"\r", b" ", b"\t"):
        raise _adcf_proof_invalid(
            "must end with the closing brace, no trailing byte"
        )
    try:
        text = raw.decode("utf-8")
    except UnicodeDecodeError as exc:
        raise _adcf_proof_invalid("is not valid UTF-8") from exc
    try:
        data = json.loads(
            text, object_pairs_hook=_reject_duplicate_adcf_proof_keys
        )
    except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
        raise _adcf_proof_invalid("is not valid JSON") from exc

    if not isinstance(data, dict):
        raise TypeError("proof must be a JSON object")
    if set(data.keys()) != _CF_PROOF_TOP_KEYS:
        raise _adcf_proof_invalid(
            "must contain exactly the keys 'payload' and 'signature'"
        )
    signature = data[SIGNATURE]
    if not isinstance(signature, str):
        raise TypeError("proof signature must be a str")
    if not _prune_is_digest(signature):
        raise _adcf_proof_invalid(
            "signature must be 64 lowercase hex characters"
        )
    payload = data[TICKET_PAYLOAD]
    if not isinstance(payload, dict):
        raise TypeError("proof payload must be an object")
    if set(payload.keys()) != _ADCF_PROOF_PAYLOAD_KEYS:
        raise _adcf_proof_invalid(
            "payload must contain exactly the keys 'chains', 'issuer', "
            "'keyVersion', 'moment', 'prunePolicy', 'report', "
            "'authorizationPolicy', 'sitePolicy' and 'version'"
        )
    issuer = payload[VD_ISSUER]
    if not isinstance(issuer, str):
        raise TypeError("payload issuer must be a str")
    if issuer == "":
        raise _adcf_proof_invalid("payload issuer must be a non-empty str")
    key_version = payload[KEY_VERSION]
    if isinstance(key_version, bool) or not isinstance(key_version, int):
        raise TypeError("payload keyVersion must be an int")
    if key_version <= 0:
        raise _adcf_proof_invalid("payload keyVersion must be positive")
    moment = payload[CP_MOMENT]
    if isinstance(moment, bool) or not isinstance(moment, int):
        raise TypeError("payload moment must be an int")
    if moment < 0:
        raise _adcf_proof_invalid("payload moment must be non-negative")
    for field in (
        CF_PROOF_PRUNE_POLICY,
        _ACF_PROOF_AUTHORIZATION_POLICY,
        _ADCF_PROOF_SITE_POLICY,
    ):
        digest = payload[field]
        if not isinstance(digest, str):
            raise TypeError(f"payload {field} must be a str")
        if not _prune_is_digest(digest):
            raise _adcf_proof_invalid(
                f"payload {field} must be 64 lowercase hex characters"
            )
    version = payload[VERSION]
    if isinstance(version, bool) or not isinstance(version, int):
        raise TypeError("payload version must be an int")
    if version != AGGREGATE_DECISION_CHAIN_FORK_PROOF_VERSION:
        raise _adcf_proof_invalid("payload version must be the integer 1")
    chains = _validated_pac_fork_chains(
        payload[FORK_PROOF_CHAINS], invalid=_adcf_proof_invalid
    )
    _validated_pac_fork_report(
        payload[FORK_PROOF_REPORT], chains,
        conflicted_error=_ADC_CHAIN_ITEM_ERROR,
        invalid=_adcf_proof_invalid,
        report_version=AGGREGATE_DECISION_CHAINS_VERSION,
        require_fork=False,
    )

    if _prune_compact(data) != raw:
        raise _adcf_proof_invalid(
            "encoding is not the canonical compact form"
        )
    return payload, signature, chains


def sign_aggregate_decision_chain_fork_proof(
    items, prune_policy, authorization_policy, site_policy, keyring, moment,
    issuer, version,
):
    """Sign the fork summary of an aggregate decision chain batch.

    ``items`` is the same non-empty list of ``{"id", "root",
    "successors", "policies"}`` dicts
    :func:`verify_aggregate_decision_chains` takes; ``prune_policy`` is
    the shared invariant original ``{"batch","sites","threshold"}``
    pruning policy, ``authorization_policy`` the shared invariant site
    authorization policy and ``site_policy`` the shared invariant
    fork-proof signer site policy, ``keyring`` follows the existing
    rules, ``moment`` is the signing time and ``issuer``/``version``
    name the signing credentials.  The batch first runs through the
    exact :func:`verify_aggregate_decision_chains` rules and the
    resulting report is bound whole, so invalid or unauthenticated
    chains never contribute a fork and a fork-free batch simply binds
    the empty fork set.  No file is read or written and no argument is
    modified.

    The proof is one canonical compact UTF-8 JSON object -- every
    object key recursively sorted, non-ASCII preserved, no trailing
    newline or any other trailing byte -- carrying exactly ``payload``
    and ``signature``.  The payload binds exactly ``chains`` (every
    input chain in input order: ``id``, the ``root`` digest, every
    ``successors`` digest and the canonical digest of every versioned
    decision site policy in the complete ``policies`` history),
    ``issuer``, ``keyVersion``, ``moment``, ``prunePolicy`` (the
    lowercase hex SHA-256 of the canonical compact prune policy
    encoding), ``report`` (the complete chain-batch report: the
    per-chain conclusions and the fork edges, possibly empty),
    ``authorizationPolicy`` (the SHA-256 of the canonical compact site
    authorization policy), ``sitePolicy`` (the SHA-256 of the canonical
    compact fork-proof signer site policy) and ``version`` (the integer
    1).  ``signature`` is the lowercase hex HMAC-SHA256 of the
    canonical compact payload bytes under the key the keyring binds to
    the exact issuer and version, with no fallback.

    A parameter or public field type fault raises :class:`TypeError` (a
    :class:`bool` never poses as an int); an empty list, an empty or
    duplicate id, a wrong policy count, an empty issuer, a non-positive
    version, a negative moment or an illegal shared policy raises
    :class:`ValueError`; and unknown, revoked, not-yet-valid or expired
    credentials raise :class:`AuthenticationError`.
    """
    validated_items = _validated_fac_chain_batch(items)
    validated_prune_policy = _validated_adjudication_policy(prune_policy)
    validated_authorization_policy = _validated_prune_batch_site_policy(
        authorization_policy
    )
    validated_site_policy = _validated_prune_batch_site_policy(site_policy)
    validated_keyring = _validated_keyring(keyring)
    sign_moment = _fe_moment(moment, "moment")
    if not isinstance(issuer, str):
        raise TypeError("issuer must be a str")
    if issuer == "":
        raise ValueError("issuer must be non-empty")
    if isinstance(version, bool) or not isinstance(version, int):
        raise TypeError("version must be an int")
    if version <= 0:
        raise ValueError("version must be positive")

    report = verify_aggregate_decision_chains(
        validated_items, prune_policy, authorization_policy, site_policy,
        keyring, sign_moment,
    )
    entry = _usable_checkpoint_key(
        validated_keyring, issuer, version, sign_moment
    )
    payload = {
        FORK_PROOF_CHAINS: _pac_chain_materials(validated_items),
        VD_ISSUER: issuer,
        KEY_VERSION: version,
        CP_MOMENT: sign_moment,
        CF_PROOF_PRUNE_POLICY: hashlib.sha256(
            _verdict_policy_bytes(validated_prune_policy)
        ).hexdigest(),
        FORK_PROOF_REPORT: copy.deepcopy(report),
        _ACF_PROOF_AUTHORIZATION_POLICY: hashlib.sha256(
            _prune_batch_site_policy_bytes(validated_authorization_policy)
        ).hexdigest(),
        _ADCF_PROOF_SITE_POLICY: hashlib.sha256(
            _prune_batch_site_policy_bytes(validated_site_policy)
        ).hexdigest(),
        VERSION: AGGREGATE_DECISION_CHAIN_FORK_PROOF_VERSION,
    }
    signature = hmac.new(
        bytes.fromhex(entry[SECRET]),
        _prune_compact(payload),
        hashlib.sha256,
    ).hexdigest()
    return _prune_compact({TICKET_PAYLOAD: payload, SIGNATURE: signature})


def _verify_adcf_fork_proof_core(
    raw: bytes,
    validated_prune_policy: dict,
    validated_authorization_policy: dict,
    validated_site_policy: dict,
    validated_keyring: dict[str, list[dict]],
    verify_moment: int,
) -> dict:
    """Verify one aggregate decision chain fork proof against validated
    materials.

    Shared core of the batch verifier; the caller owns the
    argument-type and shared-material validation.  The returned dict is
    freshly built solely from authenticated proof material.
    """
    payload, signature, chains = _parse_adcf_fork_proof(raw)
    expected_prune_digest = hashlib.sha256(
        _verdict_policy_bytes(validated_prune_policy)
    ).hexdigest()
    if payload[CF_PROOF_PRUNE_POLICY] != expected_prune_digest:
        raise _adcf_proof_invalid(
            "prune policy digest does not match the prune policy"
        )
    expected_authorization_digest = hashlib.sha256(
        _prune_batch_site_policy_bytes(validated_authorization_policy)
    ).hexdigest()
    if payload[_ACF_PROOF_AUTHORIZATION_POLICY] != \
            expected_authorization_digest:
        raise _adcf_proof_invalid(
            "authorization policy digest does not match the authorization "
            "policy"
        )
    expected_site_digest = hashlib.sha256(
        _prune_batch_site_policy_bytes(validated_site_policy)
    ).hexdigest()
    if payload[_ADCF_PROOF_SITE_POLICY] != expected_site_digest:
        raise _adcf_proof_invalid(
            "site policy digest does not match the site policy"
        )
    if payload[CP_MOMENT] > verify_moment:
        raise _adcf_proof_invalid(
            "moment must not be later than the verification moment"
        )

    key_entry = _usable_checkpoint_key(
        validated_keyring, payload[VD_ISSUER], payload[KEY_VERSION],
        verify_moment,
    )
    expected_signature = hmac.new(
        bytes.fromhex(key_entry[SECRET]),
        _prune_compact(payload),
        hashlib.sha256,
    ).hexdigest()
    if not hmac.compare_digest(expected_signature, signature):
        raise AuthenticationError(
            "aggregate decision chain fork proof signature does not match"
        )

    return {
        FORK_PROOF_CHAINS: copy.deepcopy(chains),
        VD_ISSUER: payload[VD_ISSUER],
        KEY_VERSION: payload[KEY_VERSION],
        CP_MOMENT: payload[CP_MOMENT],
        PAFD_PRUNE_POLICY_DIGEST: expected_prune_digest,
        _ACF_AUTHORIZATION_POLICY_DIGEST: expected_authorization_digest,
        _ADCF_SITE_POLICY_DIGEST: expected_site_digest,
        FORK_PROOF_DIGEST: hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),
        FORK_PROOF_REPORT: copy.deepcopy(payload[FORK_PROOF_REPORT]),
        VERSION: AGGREGATE_DECISION_CHAIN_FORK_PROOF_VERSION,
    }

def _adcf_proofs_item_report(
    item_id: str, status: str, error: str | None, result: dict | None
) -> dict:
    """One aggregate decision chain fork proof batch report, fixed order."""
    return {
        CHECKPOINT_ITEM_ERROR: error,
        ID: item_id,
        VERDICT_ITEM_RESULT: result,
        STATUS: status,
    }


def _verify_adcf_fork_proof_item(
    item: dict,
    validated_prune_policy: dict,
    validated_authorization_policy: dict,
    validated_site_policy: dict,
    validated_keyring: dict[str, list[dict]],
    moment: int,
) -> dict:
    """Verify one aggregate decision chain fork proof in isolation.

    Unknown, revoked, not-yet-valid or expired credentials and a wrong
    signature make the item ``unauthenticated``; every encoding,
    key-set, version, digest, ordering, reference or report-binding
    fault makes it ``invalid-proof``; a passing proof is ``verified``.
    """
    item_id = item[ID]
    try:
        result = _verify_adcf_fork_proof_core(
            item[FORK_PROOF_ITEM_PROOF],
            validated_prune_policy,
            validated_authorization_policy,
            validated_site_policy,
            validated_keyring,
            moment,
        )
    except AuthenticationError as exc:
        return _adcf_proofs_item_report(
            item_id, _ADCF_PROOFS_UNAUTHENTICATED, str(exc), None
        )
    except (InvalidAggregateDecisionChainForkProofError, TypeError) as exc:
        # A TypeError here can only come from a wrong JSON field type
        # *inside* the proof bytes; the public argument types were all
        # validated before the batch ran.
        return _adcf_proofs_item_report(
            item_id, _ADCF_PROOFS_INVALID, str(exc), None
        )
    return _adcf_proofs_item_report(
        item_id, _ADCF_PROOFS_VERIFIED, None, result
    )


def verify_aggregate_decision_chain_fork_proofs(
    items, prune_policy, authorization_policy, site_policy, keyring, moment,
):
    """Verify a batch of aggregate decision chain fork proofs offline.

    ``items`` is a non-empty list; each item is a dict with exactly the
    keys ``id`` (a non-empty str, unique across the batch) and ``proof``
    (the bytes :func:`sign_aggregate_decision_chain_fork_proof`
    produced).  The whole batch structure and the shared prune policy,
    site authorization policy, fork-proof signer site policy, keyring
    and moment are validated in full before any proof is verified:
    container, element or field type faults raise :class:`TypeError` (a
    :class:`bool` never poses as an int) and an empty list, an empty or
    duplicate id or a wrong item key set raises :class:`ValueError`
    (the shared materials keep their single-entry classification).
    Only these batch-level faults raise.

    Each proof is then verified independently, in strict input order,
    through the aggregate decision chain fork proof rules: one proof's
    failure never stops a later proof or alters an earlier report, and
    a failed item always keeps a null result and a definite non-empty
    error.  Unknown, revoked, not-yet-valid or expired credentials or a
    wrong signature make the item ``unauthenticated``; an illegal
    encoding, key set, version, digest, count, ordering, reference or
    report binding makes it ``invalid-proof``; a passing proof is
    ``verified``.

    The top-level result is a fresh dict with the fixed keys ``items``
    and ``version`` (the integer 1); each item report carries, in this
    key order, ``error`` (null exactly when verified), ``id``,
    ``result`` (a fresh independent copy of the single-proof result
    when verified, otherwise null -- the identity of an unauthenticated
    payload never enters a result) and ``status``.  A verified result
    carries ``proofDigest`` (the SHA-256 of the proof bytes) alongside
    the bound chains, identity, moment, three policy digests, report
    and version.  Repeated calls return equal but mutually independent
    results.  No file is read or written and no input is modified.
    """
    validated_items = _validated_pac_fork_proof_items(items)
    validated_prune_policy = _validated_adjudication_policy(prune_policy)
    validated_authorization_policy = _validated_prune_batch_site_policy(
        authorization_policy
    )
    validated_site_policy = _validated_prune_batch_site_policy(site_policy)
    validated_keyring = _validated_keyring(keyring)
    verify_moment = _fe_moment(moment, "moment")
    return {
        ITEMS: [
            _verify_adcf_fork_proof_item(
                item, validated_prune_policy, validated_authorization_policy,
                validated_site_policy, validated_keyring, verify_moment,
            )
            for item in validated_items
        ],
        VERSION: _ADCF_PROOFS_VERSION,
    }


# -- Multi-site threshold adjudication over aggregate decision chain fork
# -- proofs ------------------------------------------------------------------

def _adjudicate_adcf_one(
    item: dict,
    prune_policy_digest: str,
    authorization_policy_digest: str,
    site_policy_digest: str,
    signer_site_policy: dict,
    keyring: dict[str, list[dict]],
    moment: int,
) -> dict:
    """Verify, authorize and authenticate one fork proof in isolation.

    The proof is first checked through the exact aggregate decision
    chain fork proof structural rules, then the signing site and key
    version are authorized exactly against the separate signer site
    policy with no fallback, and finally the HMAC is checked against
    the current keyring.  Any failure rejects just this row with one
    fixed reason and never affects the other items.
    """
    item_id = item[ID]
    raw_proof = item[FORK_PROOF_ITEM_PROOF]
    proof_digest = hashlib.sha256(raw_proof).hexdigest()

    def structural_invalid() -> dict:
        return _cf_row(
            item_id, proof_digest, None, None, None,
            _PAFD_CONCLUSION_INVALID, _PAFD_REASON_INVALID_PROOF,
        )

    try:
        payload, signature, _chains = _parse_adcf_fork_proof(raw_proof)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return structural_invalid()

    site = payload[VD_ISSUER]
    key_version = payload[KEY_VERSION]
    try:
        edges = _pac_fork_proof_edges(payload)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return structural_invalid()

    def reject(reason: str) -> dict:
        return _cf_row(
            item_id, proof_digest, site, key_version, edges,
            _PAFD_CONCLUSION_INVALID, reason,
        )

    # All three shared policy digests must match and the proof must not
    # be dated after the adjudication moment; a mismatch makes the
    # claimed identity untrustworthy, so the row carries none.
    # Authorization itself is governed by the separate signer site
    # policy.
    if payload[CF_PROOF_PRUNE_POLICY] != prune_policy_digest:
        return structural_invalid()
    if payload[_ACF_PROOF_AUTHORIZATION_POLICY] != \
            authorization_policy_digest:
        return structural_invalid()
    if payload[_ADCF_PROOF_SITE_POLICY] != site_policy_digest:
        return structural_invalid()
    if payload[CP_MOMENT] > moment:
        return structural_invalid()

    allowed_versions = signer_site_policy[ADJ_SITES].get(site)
    if allowed_versions is None:
        return reject(REASON_UNAUTHORIZED_SITE)
    if key_version not in allowed_versions:
        return reject(REASON_UNAUTHORIZED_VERSION)

    key_entry = None
    for candidate in keyring.get(site, ()):
        if candidate[VERSION] == key_version:
            key_entry = candidate
            break
    if key_entry is None:
        return reject(REASON_CREDENTIAL_UNAVAILABLE)
    if key_entry[REVOKED]:
        return reject(REASON_REVOKED)
    if moment < key_entry[NOT_BEFORE]:
        return reject(REASON_NOT_YET_VALID)
    if moment > key_entry[NOT_AFTER]:
        return reject(REASON_EXPIRED)

    expected_signature = hmac.new(
        bytes.fromhex(key_entry[SECRET]),
        _prune_compact(payload),
        hashlib.sha256,
    ).hexdigest()
    if not hmac.compare_digest(expected_signature, signature):
        return reject(REASON_BAD_SIGNATURE)

    return _cf_row(
        item_id, proof_digest, site, key_version, edges,
        _PAFD_CONCLUSION_VALID, None,
    )


def adjudicate_aggregate_decision_chain_forks(
    items, prune_policy, authorization_policy, site_policy,
    signer_site_policy, keyring, moment, issuer, version,
):
    """Adjudicate multi-site aggregate decision chain fork proofs offline.

    ``items`` is a non-empty list; each item contains exactly a unique
    non-empty ``id`` and ``proof`` bytes produced by
    :func:`sign_aggregate_decision_chain_fork_proof`.  ``prune_policy``
    is the shared invariant original ``{"batch","sites","threshold"}``
    pruning policy the proofs were issued against,
    ``authorization_policy`` the invariant site authorization policy
    and ``site_policy`` the invariant fork-proof signer site policy
    their payloads digest; ``signer_site_policy`` additionally carries
    exactly ``sites`` (a non-empty map of each authorized non-empty
    signing site to its non-empty set of allowed positive key versions)
    and ``threshold`` (a positive integer no greater than the site
    count).  ``keyring`` follows the existing rules, ``moment`` is the
    non-negative adjudication moment and ``issuer``/``version`` name
    the adjudicator credentials.  No file is read or written and no
    input is modified.

    Every proof is first verified through the exact aggregate decision
    chain fork proof structural rules, then authorized by the exact
    signing site and key version its payload names with no fallback,
    then authenticated against the current keyring.  An invalid,
    unauthenticated or unauthorized proof rejects just that item with
    one fixed reason (``invalid-proof``, ``unauthorized-site``,
    ``unauthorized-version``, ``credential-unavailable``, ``revoked``,
    ``not-yet-valid``, ``expired`` or ``bad-signature``) while the
    later items are still processed.  For one site the complete fork
    edge set counts once -- extra proofs declaring an identical edge
    set are ``duplicate`` -- while distinct valid edge sets from one
    site are a ``contradiction``.  Distinct sites must agree exactly on
    the complete fork edge set (possibly the empty set); any
    contradiction or cross-site disagreement is ``conflicted`` with a
    null common edge set and no majority can outvote it.  A unique edge
    set backed by at least the threshold of distinct sites is
    ``accepted``; the same unique set short of the threshold stays
    ``insufficient`` yet still binds that common set; with no valid
    vote the common set is null.  The input order never changes the
    result bytes: the rows are stably sorted by site then id and the
    proof digest vector follows the sorted rows term by term.

    The result is one canonical compact UTF-8 JSON object with
    recursively sorted keys, non-ASCII preserved and no trailing byte,
    carrying exactly ``payload`` and ``signature``.  The payload binds
    exactly ``common`` (the sorted common fork edge set, possibly
    empty, or null), ``issuer``, ``items`` (the rows stably sorted by
    site then id, each carrying ``conclusion``, its authenticated
    ``edges`` or null, ``id``, ``keyVersion``, ``proofDigest``,
    ``reason`` and ``site``), ``keyVersion``, ``prunePolicyDigest``,
    ``authorizationPolicyDigest``, ``sitePolicyDigest``,
    ``signerSitePolicyDigest``, ``proofs`` (each proof digest in the
    canonical row order), ``status`` and ``version`` (the integer 1).
    ``signature`` is the lowercase hex HMAC-SHA256 of the canonical
    compact payload bytes under the exact issuer/version key.

    A parameter, container or public-field type fault raises
    :class:`TypeError` (a :class:`bool` never poses as an int); an
    empty list, an empty or duplicate id, or an illegal policy,
    threshold, moment, issuer or version raises :class:`ValueError`;
    unknown, revoked, not-yet-valid or expired adjudicator credentials
    raise :class:`AuthenticationError`.
    """
    validated_items = _validated_pac_fork_proof_items(items)
    validated_prune_policy = _validated_adjudication_policy(prune_policy)
    validated_authorization_policy = _validated_prune_batch_site_policy(
        authorization_policy
    )
    validated_site_policy = _validated_prune_batch_site_policy(site_policy)
    validated_signer_site_policy = _validated_prune_batch_site_policy(
        signer_site_policy
    )
    validated_keyring = _validated_keyring(keyring)
    if isinstance(moment, bool) or not isinstance(moment, int):
        raise TypeError("moment must be an int")
    if moment < 0:
        raise ValueError("moment must be non-negative")
    if not isinstance(issuer, str):
        raise TypeError("issuer must be a str")
    if issuer == "":
        raise ValueError("issuer must be non-empty")
    if isinstance(version, bool) or not isinstance(version, int):
        raise TypeError("version must be an int")
    if version <= 0:
        raise ValueError("version must be positive")

    prune_policy_digest = hashlib.sha256(
        _verdict_policy_bytes(validated_prune_policy)
    ).hexdigest()
    authorization_policy_digest = hashlib.sha256(
        _prune_batch_site_policy_bytes(validated_authorization_policy)
    ).hexdigest()
    site_policy_digest = hashlib.sha256(
        _prune_batch_site_policy_bytes(validated_site_policy)
    ).hexdigest()

    rows = [
        _adjudicate_adcf_one(
            item, prune_policy_digest, authorization_policy_digest,
            site_policy_digest, validated_signer_site_policy,
            validated_keyring, moment,
        )
        for item in validated_items
    ]

    contradicted, votes = _tally_pac_fork_rows(rows)

    edge_sets = set(votes.values())
    if contradicted or len(edge_sets) > 1:
        status = _CF_STATUS_CONFLICTED
        common = None
    elif len(edge_sets) == 1:
        common = _sorted_pac_fork_edge_objects(next(iter(edge_sets)))
        if len(votes) >= validated_signer_site_policy[ADJ_THRESHOLD]:
            status = _CF_STATUS_ACCEPTED
        else:
            status = _CF_STATUS_INSUFFICIENT
    else:
        status = _CF_STATUS_INSUFFICIENT
        common = None

    rows.sort(
        key=lambda row: (
            row[VD_ISSUER] is not None,
            row[VD_ISSUER] or "",
            row[ID],
        )
    )
    # The proof summary vector corresponds term by term to the canonical
    # (sorted) rows, so a reordering of the summaries that is then
    # re-signed is detectable offline without seeing any proof even
    # though the digest multiset is unchanged.
    proof_digests = [row[_CF_PROOF_DIGEST] for row in rows]

    signing_entry = _usable_checkpoint_key(
        validated_keyring, issuer, version, moment
    )
    payload = {
        PAFD_COMMON: common,
        VD_ISSUER: issuer,
        ITEMS: [copy.deepcopy(row) for row in rows],
        KEY_VERSION: version,
        PAFD_PRUNE_POLICY_DIGEST: prune_policy_digest,
        _ACF_DECISION_AUTHORIZATION_POLICY_DIGEST:
            authorization_policy_digest,
        _ADCF_SITE_POLICY_DIGEST: site_policy_digest,
        _ADCF_SIGNER_SITE_POLICY_DIGEST: hashlib.sha256(
            _prune_batch_site_policy_bytes(validated_signer_site_policy)
        ).hexdigest(),
        PAFD_PROOFS: proof_digests,
        STATUS: status,
        VERSION: AGGREGATE_DECISION_CHAIN_FORK_DECISION_VERSION,
    }
    signature = hmac.new(
        bytes.fromhex(signing_entry[SECRET]),
        _prune_compact(payload),
        hashlib.sha256,
    ).hexdigest()
    return _prune_compact({TICKET_PAYLOAD: payload, SIGNATURE: signature})


def _parse_adcf_decision(raw: object) -> tuple[dict, str]:
    """Validate aggregate decision chain fork decision bytes structurally.

    A non-bytes argument or a field of the wrong type raises
    :class:`TypeError` (a :class:`bool` never poses as an int); every
    encoding, key-set, version, digest or value-format fault raises
    :class:`InvalidAggregateDecisionChainForkDecisionError`.  The
    policy, tally and credential bindings are checked by the decision
    verifier.
    """
    if not isinstance(raw, bytes):
        raise TypeError("decision must be bytes")
    if not raw or raw[-1:] in (b"\n", b"\r", b" ", b"\t"):
        raise _adcf_decision_invalid(
            "must end with the closing brace, no trailing byte"
        )
    try:
        text = raw.decode("utf-8")
    except UnicodeDecodeError as exc:
        raise _adcf_decision_invalid("is not valid UTF-8") from exc
    try:
        data = json.loads(
            text, object_pairs_hook=_reject_duplicate_adcf_decision_keys
        )
    except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
        raise _adcf_decision_invalid("is not valid JSON") from exc

    if not isinstance(data, dict):
        raise TypeError("decision must be a JSON object")
    if set(data.keys()) != _PAFD_DECISION_TOP_KEYS:
        raise _adcf_decision_invalid(
            "must contain exactly the keys 'payload' and 'signature'"
        )
    signature = data[SIGNATURE]
    if not isinstance(signature, str):
        raise TypeError("decision signature must be a str")
    if not _prune_is_digest(signature):
        raise _adcf_decision_invalid(
            "signature must be 64 lowercase hex characters"
        )
    payload = data[TICKET_PAYLOAD]
    if not isinstance(payload, dict):
        raise TypeError("decision payload must be an object")
    if set(payload.keys()) != _ADCF_DECISION_PAYLOAD_KEYS:
        raise _adcf_decision_invalid(
            "payload must contain exactly the keys 'common', 'issuer', "
            "'items', 'keyVersion', 'prunePolicyDigest', 'proofs', "
            "'authorizationPolicyDigest', 'sitePolicyDigest', "
            "'signerSitePolicyDigest', 'status' and 'version'"
        )

    issuer = payload[VD_ISSUER]
    if not isinstance(issuer, str):
        raise TypeError("payload issuer must be a str")
    if issuer == "":
        raise _adcf_decision_invalid(
            "payload issuer must be a non-empty str"
        )
    key_version = payload[KEY_VERSION]
    if isinstance(key_version, bool) or not isinstance(key_version, int):
        raise TypeError("payload keyVersion must be an int")
    if key_version <= 0:
        raise _adcf_decision_invalid("payload keyVersion must be positive")
    status = payload[STATUS]
    if not isinstance(status, str):
        raise TypeError("payload status must be a str")
    if status not in _PAFD_STATUSES:
        raise _adcf_decision_invalid("payload status is not a known status")
    for field in (
        PAFD_PRUNE_POLICY_DIGEST,
        _ACF_DECISION_AUTHORIZATION_POLICY_DIGEST,
        _ADCF_SITE_POLICY_DIGEST,
        _ADCF_SIGNER_SITE_POLICY_DIGEST,
    ):
        digest = payload[field]
        if not isinstance(digest, str):
            raise TypeError(f"payload {field} must be a str")
        if not _prune_is_digest(digest):
            raise _adcf_decision_invalid(
                f"payload {field} must be 64 lowercase hex characters"
            )

    proofs = payload[PAFD_PROOFS]
    if not isinstance(proofs, list):
        raise TypeError("payload proofs must be a list")
    if not proofs:
        raise _adcf_decision_invalid("payload proofs must be non-empty")
    for position, digest in enumerate(proofs):
        if not isinstance(digest, str):
            raise TypeError(f"payload proof {position} digest must be a str")
        if not _prune_is_digest(digest):
            raise _adcf_decision_invalid(
                f"payload proof {position} digest must be 64 lowercase hex "
                "characters"
            )

    raw_rows = payload[ITEMS]
    if not isinstance(raw_rows, list):
        raise TypeError("payload items must be a list")
    if not raw_rows:
        raise _adcf_decision_invalid("payload items must be non-empty")
    seen_ids: set[str] = set()
    for position, row in enumerate(raw_rows):
        where = f"payload item {position}"
        if not isinstance(row, dict):
            raise TypeError(f"{where} must be an object")
        if set(row.keys()) != _PAFD_ROW_KEYS:
            raise _adcf_decision_invalid(
                f"{where} must contain exactly the keys 'conclusion', "
                "'edges', 'id', 'keyVersion', 'digest', 'reason' and "
                "'site'"
            )
        row_id = row[ID]
        if not isinstance(row_id, str):
            raise TypeError(f"{where} id must be a str")
        if row_id == "":
            raise _adcf_decision_invalid(f"{where} id must be non-empty")
        if row_id in seen_ids:
            raise _adcf_decision_invalid(f"{where} repeats an id")
        seen_ids.add(row_id)
        digest = row[_CF_PROOF_DIGEST]
        if not isinstance(digest, str):
            raise TypeError(f"{where} digest must be a str")
        if not _prune_is_digest(digest):
            raise _adcf_decision_invalid(
                f"{where} digest must be 64 lowercase hex characters"
            )
        site = row[VD_ISSUER]
        if site is not None:
            if not isinstance(site, str):
                raise TypeError(f"{where} site must be a str or null")
            if site == "":
                raise _adcf_decision_invalid(
                    f"{where} site must be non-empty"
                )
        row_key_version = row[KEY_VERSION]
        if isinstance(row_key_version, bool) or not isinstance(
            row_key_version, int
        ):
            if row_key_version is not None:
                raise TypeError(f"{where} keyVersion must be an int or null")
        elif row_key_version <= 0:
            raise _adcf_decision_invalid(
                f"{where} keyVersion must be positive"
            )
        if (site is None) != (row_key_version is None):
            raise _adcf_decision_invalid(
                f"{where} site and keyVersion must be null together"
            )
        conclusion = row[ADJ_CONCLUSION]
        if not isinstance(conclusion, str):
            raise TypeError(f"{where} conclusion must be a str")
        if conclusion not in _PAFD_CONCLUSIONS:
            raise _adcf_decision_invalid(f"{where} conclusion is not known")
        reason = row[ADJ_REASON]
        if conclusion == _PAFD_CONCLUSION_VALID:
            if reason is not None:
                raise _adcf_decision_invalid(
                    f"{where} reason must be null for a valid item"
                )
        else:
            if not isinstance(reason, str):
                raise TypeError(f"{where} reason must be a str")
            if reason not in _PAFD_REASONS:
                raise _adcf_decision_invalid(f"{where} reason is not known")
        if conclusion == _PAFD_CONCLUSION_INVALID:
            if reason not in _PAFD_INVALID_REASONS:
                raise _adcf_decision_invalid(
                    f"{where} reason does not match an invalid item"
                )
        elif conclusion != _PAFD_CONCLUSION_VALID:
            if reason != conclusion:
                raise _adcf_decision_invalid(
                    f"{where} reason must match its conclusion"
                )

        raw_edges = row[PAFD_EDGES]
        if raw_edges is not None:
            if not isinstance(raw_edges, list):
                raise TypeError(f"{where} edges must be a list or null")
            row_edges = [
                _validated_pafd_edge(value, where, _adcf_decision_invalid)
                for value in raw_edges
            ]
            triples = _pac_fork_edge_triples(row_edges)
            if len(set(triples)) != len(triples):
                raise _adcf_decision_invalid(f"{where} edges must be unique")
            if list(triples) != sorted(triples):
                raise _adcf_decision_invalid(
                    f"{where} edges must be sorted ascending"
                )
        identity_expected = reason != _PAFD_REASON_INVALID_PROOF
        if identity_expected:
            if site is None or raw_edges is None:
                raise _adcf_decision_invalid(
                    f"{where} an authenticated proof must carry its site and "
                    "fork edges"
                )
        else:
            if site is not None or raw_edges is not None:
                raise _adcf_decision_invalid(
                    f"{where} an invalid-proof item must carry no site or "
                    "fork edges"
                )

    common = payload[PAFD_COMMON]
    if common is not None:
        if not isinstance(common, list):
            raise TypeError("payload common must be a list or null")
        common_edges = [
            _validated_pafd_edge(value, "payload common",
                                 _adcf_decision_invalid)
            for value in common
        ]
        common_triples = _pac_fork_edge_triples(common_edges)
        if len(set(common_triples)) != len(common_triples) or list(
            common_triples
        ) != sorted(common_triples):
            raise _adcf_decision_invalid(
                "payload common edges must be unique and sorted ascending"
            )

    decision_version = payload[VERSION]
    if isinstance(decision_version, bool) or not isinstance(
        decision_version, int
    ):
        raise TypeError("payload version must be an int")
    if decision_version != AGGREGATE_DECISION_CHAIN_FORK_DECISION_VERSION:
        raise _adcf_decision_invalid("payload version must be the integer 1")

    if _prune_compact(data) != raw:
        raise _adcf_decision_invalid(
            "encoding is not the canonical compact form"
        )
    return payload, signature


def verify_aggregate_decision_chain_fork_decision(
    decision, prune_policy, authorization_policy, site_policy,
    signer_site_policy, keyring, moment,
):
    """Re-verify an aggregate decision chain fork decision fully offline.

    Only the decision bytes, the expected shared ``prune_policy``, the
    invariant site ``authorization_policy``, the invariant fork-proof
    ``site_policy``, the expected ``signer_site_policy``, the current
    ``keyring`` and the verification ``moment`` are consulted -- no
    file is read or written and no argument is modified.  The decision
    binds four policy digests (the prune policy, the site authorization
    policy, the fork-proof signer site policy and the adjudication
    signer site policy).  Verification validates the canonical encoding
    and every key set, recomputes all four policy digests, re-tallies
    the bound per-proof rows purely from the signed payload (the
    term-by-term proof digest bindings over the canonical rows, the
    stable site/id row ordering, the same-site duplicate/contradiction
    markings, the cross-site complete edge-set agreement, the signer
    threshold outcome and the claimed common set), and checks the
    HMAC-SHA256 against the key the current keyring binds to the
    payload's exact issuer and version, usable at the verification
    moment, so a later revocation or expiry rejects the decision with
    no fallback.

    On success a fresh depth-independent mapping is returned with the
    fixed keys ``common``, ``proofDigest`` (the SHA-256 of the decision
    bytes), ``issuer``, ``items``, ``keyVersion``,
    ``prunePolicyDigest``, ``authorizationPolicyDigest``,
    ``sitePolicyDigest``, ``signerSitePolicyDigest``, ``proofs``,
    ``status`` and ``version`` (the integer 1); repeated calls return
    equal but mutually independent objects and unauthenticated
    identities and boundaries never enter a result.  A non-bytes
    decision or a wrong public field type raises :class:`TypeError` (a
    :class:`bool` never poses as an int); an empty value, a duplicate
    id, a wrong key set or an illegal policy, threshold, moment,
    identity or version raises :class:`ValueError`; an illegal decision
    structure, ordering, tally or binding raises
    :class:`InvalidAggregateDecisionChainForkDecisionError` (a
    :class:`ValueError` subclass, distinct from
    :class:`InvalidAggregateDecisionChainForkProofError`); unknown,
    revoked, not-yet-valid or expired credentials or a wrong signature
    raise :class:`AuthenticationError`.
    """
    if not isinstance(decision, bytes):
        raise TypeError("decision must be bytes")
    validated_prune_policy = _validated_adjudication_policy(prune_policy)
    validated_authorization_policy = _validated_prune_batch_site_policy(
        authorization_policy
    )
    validated_site_policy = _validated_prune_batch_site_policy(site_policy)
    validated_signer_site_policy = _validated_prune_batch_site_policy(
        signer_site_policy
    )
    validated_keyring = _validated_keyring(keyring)
    verify_moment = _fe_moment(moment, "moment")
    return _verify_adcf_decision_core(
        decision, validated_prune_policy, validated_authorization_policy,
        validated_site_policy, validated_signer_site_policy,
        validated_keyring, verify_moment,
    )


def _verify_adcf_decision_core(
    decision: bytes,
    validated_prune_policy: dict,
    validated_authorization_policy: dict,
    validated_site_policy: dict,
    validated_signer_site_policy: dict,
    validated_keyring: dict[str, list[dict]],
    verify_moment: int,
) -> dict:
    """Verify one aggregate decision chain fork decision.

    The caller owns the argument-type and shared-material validation.
    The returned dict is freshly built solely from authenticated
    decision material.
    """
    payload, signature = _parse_adcf_decision(decision)
    expected_prune_digest = hashlib.sha256(
        _verdict_policy_bytes(validated_prune_policy)
    ).hexdigest()
    if payload[PAFD_PRUNE_POLICY_DIGEST] != expected_prune_digest:
        raise _adcf_decision_invalid(
            "prune policy digest does not match the prune policy"
        )
    expected_authorization_digest = hashlib.sha256(
        _prune_batch_site_policy_bytes(validated_authorization_policy)
    ).hexdigest()
    if payload[_ACF_DECISION_AUTHORIZATION_POLICY_DIGEST] != \
            expected_authorization_digest:
        raise _adcf_decision_invalid(
            "authorization policy digest does not match the authorization "
            "policy"
        )
    expected_site_digest = hashlib.sha256(
        _prune_batch_site_policy_bytes(validated_site_policy)
    ).hexdigest()
    if payload[_ADCF_SITE_POLICY_DIGEST] != expected_site_digest:
        raise _adcf_decision_invalid(
            "site policy digest does not match the site policy"
        )
    expected_signer_digest = hashlib.sha256(
        _prune_batch_site_policy_bytes(validated_signer_site_policy)
    ).hexdigest()
    if payload[_ADCF_SIGNER_SITE_POLICY_DIGEST] != expected_signer_digest:
        raise _adcf_decision_invalid(
            "signer site policy digest does not match the signer site policy"
        )

    # The proof digest vector is bound term by term to the canonical
    # (stably sorted) rows, so a reordering of the summaries that is then
    # re-signed is rejected even though the digest multiset is unchanged.
    status = _reconcile_pafd(
        payload, validated_signer_site_policy[ADJ_THRESHOLD],
        invalid=_adcf_decision_invalid, positional_proofs=True,
    )

    entry = _usable_checkpoint_key(
        validated_keyring, payload[VD_ISSUER], payload[KEY_VERSION],
        verify_moment,
    )
    expected_signature = hmac.new(
        bytes.fromhex(entry[SECRET]),
        _prune_compact(payload),
        hashlib.sha256,
    ).hexdigest()
    if not hmac.compare_digest(expected_signature, signature):
        raise AuthenticationError(
            "aggregate decision chain fork decision signature does not match"
        )

    return {
        key: copy.deepcopy(value)
        for key, value in (
            (PAFD_COMMON, payload[PAFD_COMMON]),
            (FORK_PROOF_DIGEST, hashlib.sha256(decision).hexdigest()),
            (VD_ISSUER, payload[VD_ISSUER]),
            (ITEMS, payload[ITEMS]),
            (KEY_VERSION, payload[KEY_VERSION]),
            (PAFD_PRUNE_POLICY_DIGEST, expected_prune_digest),
            (_ACF_DECISION_AUTHORIZATION_POLICY_DIGEST,
             expected_authorization_digest),
            (_ADCF_SITE_POLICY_DIGEST, expected_site_digest),
            (_ADCF_SIGNER_SITE_POLICY_DIGEST, expected_signer_digest),
            (PAFD_PROOFS, payload[PAFD_PROOFS]),
            (STATUS, status),
            (VERSION, AGGREGATE_DECISION_CHAIN_FORK_DECISION_VERSION),
        )
    }
